purpose: Research contract mapping representative musical claims to evidence prerequisites and fail-closed readiness. This file does not enable product exposure.

claims.claim_text: Identify the work-level key without implying local key regions.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold when global key evidence is unavailable; never reinterpret the global estimate as a modulation or local-key claim.

claims.claim_text: Name the detected chord over a localized supported span.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold spans where the trusted chord path emits no supported chord; do not extend validation to arbitrary polyphonic domains without evidence.

claims.claim_text: Compare note-density measurements between two user-selected spans.
claims.abstention_rule: Do not name verse/chorus/section roles unless trusted structure evidence exists; present only the measured contrast for the selected spans.

claims.claim_text: Compare literal perceptual-series measurements between two explicit spans of the same source version.
validated_domains: within-work comparison under identical canonical mono 22.05 kHz preprocessing
claims.abstention_rule: Require compatible source lineage, identical preprocessing, adequate span coverage, and finite values. Report only literal RMS-amplitude-proxy, onset-strength, spectral-centroid, or relative-band measurements; do not convert them into semantic timbre, affect, source, section, or calibrated-loudness claims.

claims.claim_text: Identify the localized highest register reached by the extracted melody.
validated_domains: pop/arranged symbolic MIDI via the current LStoM evaluation
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold outside the validated melody domain or when melody extraction is unavailable; do not generalize the current POP909 result to arbitrary piano or recorded-music transcription.

claims.claim_text: Claim that one detected formal section is denser than another.
claims.abstention_rule: Do not attach density comparisons to detected section labels while section evidence remains evaluation-only; allow user-selected spans instead.
claims.upstream_blocker: trusted section boundaries and repetition evidence

claims.claim_text: Identify a melodic idea returning in transposed form.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold until both melody extraction and recurrence matching are validated for the target domain; current motif matching is evaluation-only.
claims.upstream_blocker: validated melody correspondence and transposition-normalized motif matching

claims.claim_text: Claim that a localized onset or layer repeatedly anticipates the downbeat.
claims.abstention_rule: A global tempo estimate is insufficient. Withhold until beat/downbeat phase, event coverage, and localized onset evidence are validated at claim-appropriate tolerances; precise timing on a sparse matched subset is not sufficient.
claims.upstream_blocker: independent metric-grid validation with localization plus coverage, then beat-relative source/onset timing

claims.claim_text: Measure how localized vocal or syllable events are offset from a trusted metric grid across a phrase or comparison span.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold when grid phase or vocal-event timing uncertainty is comparable to the measured offset; do not collapse the measured coordination relation into generic syncopation or expressive meaning.
claims.upstream_blocker: trusted local metric grid plus validated vocal/syllable onset localization

claims.claim_text: Claim that one performer responds to another through a localized motivic or phrase-level relationship.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold when performer/source attribution is ambiguous or motif correspondence is unvalidated; simultaneity or generic timing correlation is not evidence of response.
claims.upstream_blocker: source-aware evidence plus validated motif/recurrence relations

claims.claim_text: Interpret a chromatic harmonic event as intensifying motion toward the dominant.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold outside an explicitly compatible tonal framework or when local tonal context is not trustworthy; oracle theory-interpreter scores are not end-to-end evidence.
claims.upstream_blocker: validated local tonal context and end-to-end chord/key sensitivity

claims.claim_text: Explain a large transition as the convergence of measured energy/spectrum changes and independently supported layer-activity changes.
claims.abstention_rule: PerceptualSeries can support literal before/after measurements but cannot by itself establish a drop or arrangement explanation. Require independently supported layer activity and an explicit or trusted transition span.

claims.claim_text: Identify a local modulation or key-region change.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold while key-region evidence is explicitly withheld; a global key estimate cannot substitute for local modulation evidence.

claims.claim_text: Name a cadence or resolution within a tonal framework.
claims.abstention_rule: Withhold while cadence evidence remains below the product gate or when the analytical framework is not applicable.
claims.upstream_blocker: held-out cadence quality plus reliable local tonal and phrase context

claims.claim_text: Explain why a passage feels more exciting, warm, tense, or otherwise subjectively different because of a measured feature.
claims.abstention_rule: Never treat low-level descriptor movement as a universal perceptual adjective or causal explanation. Keep the measured relation factual and any affective interpretation explicitly hypothetical, contextual, and open to alternative readings.
claims.upstream_blocker: task-level semantic validation and explicit interpretive evidence composition rather than another low-level detector
